script.base: SoFi dome, Rams -3, total 49.5, so the book expects Los Angeles to lead by about a field goal with both teams in the mid-20s (LA 26.2, SEA 23.2), not a blowout. Both run defenses travel (LA 3.92 YPC, SEA 3.80 YPC), so the 49.5 points lean pass: Jaxon Smith-Njigba 29 targets/345 yards/363 air yards is the Seattle engine, while Los Angeles splits Davante Adams 23/172, Puka Nacua 14/159, Tyler Higbee 13/65 and Terrance Ferguson 10/117. Walker projects near 14 carries and Kyren near 17, not 22-touch grinds.
script.flip1: Rams jump up by 14 early, Stafford and the wideouts stall after the lead, and Kyren/Corum clock it out. Seattle abandons the run the way a trailing dog does, so Walker and Charbonnet rush yards die while Smith-Njigba, Cooper Kupp and the Tory Horton replacement targets spike.
script.flip2: Shootout or Seattle leads: both quarterbacks throw, correlated pass overs hit together, Kyren's late-carry script flips off, and Jalen Sundell being out turns Smith-Njigba's 12.5 air-yards-per-target role into checkdowns to AJ Barner, Walker and Charbonnet instead of a 120-yard receiving day.

The bettable overlap is the reverse: Walker into a 3.92 YPC front with Sundell out and Charbonnet still taking 34 carries, and Kyren into a 3.80 YPC front with Corum still taking 38 carries and no L3 targets logged.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and both Seattle-at-Rams unders lost. Kobie Turner sat, the Rams' 3.92 YPC was the wrong front, and Walker turned about 18 carries plus one of the 21 chunk runs LA has allowed into the 67-yard template or better while Charbonnet was the back who got scripted down. On the Rams side Los Angeles led wire to wire, Corum never saw the 12-carry share from weeks 7/9/10, and Kyren stacked a 70-yard rush day with the checkdowns Seattle's 23 percent blitz invites, clearing 87.5 the same way the 114-yard game did. The correlated killer is a low-scoring grind this 49.5 dome total is not pricing as the base. That counter-case is real, which is why both legs are leans rather than strong, but it is not stronger than the base read of two committees into sub-4.0 fronts.
